observations: Opened assets/panels/05-4.png. The clinic entrance has a teal awning and morning sun with leaf shadows on the white wall. The street and trees are at right and there is no signage.

Ravi walks screen-right while turning back with a smile. He waves with his right hand (raised, five fingers). His left hand, which has the watch, holds the navy phone low at his side. The bag is on his shoulder. This matches production.hands.ravi and heldBy ravi.left.

Ananya is inside the glass doorway: low bun, white coat, teal kurta, stethoscope around her neck. She waves with her right hand (viewer-left, since she faces the reader) and her left hand hangs relaxed. Meera stands beside her with the braid over her left shoulder and waves with her left hand (viewer-right), her right hand at her side. Both match the record.
The faces are small, but each one's features read as its sheet character. The acting matches 'reassured, light'.

Minor continuity note across pages 5-6, not blocking: Ravi's bag strap and bag swap sides between panels. Here the strap is on his left shoulder with the bag at his right hip. In 06-4 and the cast sheet the bag sits on his right side.
On page-05.png the narration box sits in the empty top-left band and slightly overlaps the edge of the awning. It covers no figure.
